scripts.db:backup: source .env && docker exec $(docker ps -qf "name=$DB_HOST") /usr/bin/mysqldump -u root --password=$DB_PASS $DB_DATABASE > snapshot_dev.sql
scripts.db:restore: source .env && docker exec -i $(docker ps -qf "name=$DB_HOST") /usr/bin/mysql -u root --password=$DB_PASS $DB_DATABASE < snapshot_dev.sql && clear
